internal.title: High Latency Incident in Ad Service Due to CPU Resource Exhaustion
internal.body:
On 2026-11-08 at 12:33 UTC, an alert for high latency in the ad service was triggered. Diagnosis identified resource exhaustion caused by high CPU utilization coinciding with the activation of the 'adHighCpu' flag. The flag was promptly disabled at 12:53 UTC, resulting in verified recovery with latency returning to normal levels. No errors or memory leaks were detected, and a bad deployment was ruled out. The incident was resolved by disabling the flag causing the CPU spike.

Timeline:
- 12:33:33 Alert received for high latency
- 12:53:20 Diagnosis confirmed resource exhaustion due to high CPU
- 12:53:31 Flag 'adHighCpu' disabled
- 12:53:31 Recovery verified with latency normalized

Action taken:
- Disabled 'adHighCpu' flag

Please monitor CPU usage closely when enabling feature flags to avoid similar incidents.
